title: 실시간 사이버수업의 운영전략 탐색을 위한 사례연구
keywords: web-based realtime learning for high school students
instructional strategies for online realtime teaching

abstracts.value: 본 연구는 고등학교에서의 실시간 사이버수업 사례를 통해 실시간 사이버교육 운영전략을 모색해보았다. 이를 위해 고등학교 실시간 사이버수업 사례를 온라인 상에서 직접 관찰하였고 녹화된 수업자료를 분석하였으며, 학습자와 교수자를 대상으로 설문조사와 인터뷰를 실시하였다. 관찰 결과, 교사는 학생들과 함께 탐구하고 토론하는 상호작용적인 수업을 진행하였으며, 학생들 또한 매우 적극적으로 수업에 참여하는 것을 볼 수 있었다. 실시간 사이버수업의 장애요인으로, 학생들의 지각 현상 채팅을 이용하여 학습내용과 관계없는 이야기를 하는 점, 일부 학생들이 수업창에 접속해놓은 상태에서 다른 사이트에 들어가거나 출석 확인이 쉽지 않은 점, 학생들의 가정 컴퓨터 환경의 차이에 따른 기술적인 문제들이 있음이 확인되었다. 본 연구 결과를 토대로, 실시간 사이버수업의 운영전략을 제안하였다.

This study was intended to analyze the instructional process involved in the web-based realtime instruction in a high school. More specifically, the effectiveness of online realtime instruction as well as the problems associated with this type of instruction were explored. For this purpose, the online observation of the instruction was undertaken, and the recorded instruction was watched in order to identify the types, frequencies, and methods of the interactions used between the teacher and students as well as those among the students. In addition, a student survey and teacher interviews were conducted.
Overall, students appeared to be very active in this cyber class. It seemed that students enjoyed this realtime instruction very much, especially text-based realtime interaction with their peers. However, it was found that realtime chatting can also interfere with students' learning process by distracting their attention. This problem was relieved more or less when the teacher controlled students' chatting by opening the chat window only when necessary. Some problems occurred include the teacher's not being able to control some students' doing other things rather than attending class, a few students' not being able to follow the teacher's pace, and some technical problems caused by students' computers and networks.
